name: J. J. Hill
role: St. Paul railroad man (Manitoba Road) and Aberdeen-Angus breeder
bio: The St. Paul railroad builder appears as a breeder of Aberdeen-Angus cattle, buying a small herd in Scotland in 1885 and taking first prize at the Chicago Fat Stock Show that November; in January 1886 the paper reported further Chicago honors for his steers, including Benholm. In December 1886 the paper reported him pressing for a bill giving his Manitoba Road right of way across the Fort Berthold and Blackfeet reservations.
